notes.title: SafeZoneVR UPDATE - OUT NOW - Full VR Headset Support
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

This update includes the following: 

Major:
- Full VR Headset support - all headsets should now work with the game
- Virtual Desktop support 
- Major FPS Fixes across the game
- New Main Menu Environment/Music
- Added hidden story around the game

Minor:
- Updated the Hide and Seek with new hiding spots and adjusted ones
- You can now hide behind the barrel (Thanks DannyJ1992 on twitch for finding this) 
- Fixed bug where you could walk off elevator in "cutscene"
- Added light in first spawn room so you now know where to look for keycard 

Watch the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=zjZM6Hprzdc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for 20k Downloads! 
JOIN COMMUNITY DISCORD: https://discord.gg/GXUpHvxmKu

notes.title: Major Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Sorry for the confusion this morning with the game reaching an unplayable state, make sure to install this update and play SafeZoneVR bug free! 

BUGS FIXED:
White Box after clicking play button in menu
Missing Executable Runtime (Rarely Occurred) 
Fixed support for CV1 Bug

notes.title: Post Release Bug Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed loading screen bug
Fixed intro to game not playing bug

notes.title: Game Release Delay
notes.notes:
SafeZoneVR will now be releasing on August 27 instead of August 20. So sorry about the inconvenience.
The reason for this is ironing out certain bugs that Steams reviewers found when testing my game. I have been hard at work EVERY SINGLE day and night on this game for the last 4 weeks. I am sorry about the delay and tried to prevent it. 
- Will Codes

(The game will [i]probably[/i] also be releasing with only Oculus sdk headset support for the initial release. I had the other headsets included and coded in but can't test them without the valve index for example, when reviewed by steam I was informed they were not working. Sorry for the inconvenience, expect an update with wider headset support soon after release.
